executor_profile.justification: Control-loop design (AIMD tuning, shed/preemption ordering, offload diversion gating) with failure modes spanning every spawn site the governor fronts; getting width-adjustment or shed ordering wrong fails silently (starvation, oscillation) rather than loudly, warranting opus over sonnet. An advisory second opinion specifically targets control-loop stability (oscillation under adversarial 429 patterns, starvation in the requeue ledger) given the four absorbed ideas propose meaningfully different mechanisms that must reconcile into one coherent module. Effort is target posture: not a live team-execution dispatch knob until pf-effort-first-class lands; teammates inherit session tier until then.
